ideas.pitch: An automated program design tool that takes high-level molecular Hamiltonian descriptions and compiles them into heavily optimized, depth-reduced Qiskit quantum circuits using heuristic routing.
ideas.title: Qiskit Variational Eigensolver Circuit Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core theme of Program Design within a quantum computing context using Qiskit, aligning perfectly with judge expectations for algorithmic depth in a solo timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A program design framework that models quantum error mitigation strategies as formal BPMN workflows, orchestrating automated circuit patching before execution on Qiskit runtime backends.
ideas.title: Quantum Error Mitigation BPMN Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous workflow governance patterns with quantum execution pipelines, demonstrating high technical complexity suitable for a solo developer.

ideas.pitch: A specialized semantic router and code synthesis agent that translates natural language math descriptions directly into valid, syntax-checked Qiskit Python scripts.
ideas.title: Qiskit LLM-Assisted Quantum Circuit Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a self-improving semantic routing architecture to guarantee high generation accuracy for niche quantum syntax, matching proven architectures from previous hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An agentic system that analyzes quantum assembly code, detects decoherence vulnerabilities, and applies verified automated fixes directly back into the repository.
ideas.title: Autonomous Quantum Bug Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an autonomous incident response pattern with an evidence gate and verified repair, creating a compelling demo for program design evaluation.

ideas.pitch: Two competing AI agents where one agent generates inefficient Qiskit circuits and the other generates optimal refactorings, engaging in adversarial reinforcement learning to discover novel compilation heuristics.
ideas.title: Adversarial Quantum Circuit Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses an adversarial self-improving agent architecture that naturally uncovers complex optimization strategies without heavy manual seed engineering.
